notes: Curated catalog for the repository dossier. Curatorial text lives here; live repository facts, READMEs, trees, commits, languages and vendored builds are added by scripts/sync-repos.mjs at sync time.

repositories.rights: MIT license reported in the repository; permissive but non-exclusive. Review contributor and third-party asset terms before commercial release.
repositories.status: Single-file build. The full upstream app is embedded on this site and is also deployed at GitHub Pages.
